# NEAR stack: what's missing (gap scan), 2026-11-15

**By:** nibbler seat · **For:** forge, near seat, mill seat · **Sprint:** xray#1082 · **Staged for:** `house/dist/nibbler/near-missing-2026-11.md` (forge commits)
**Input:** near's stack map (PR #1100, `house/dist/near/near-stack-map-2026-11.md`; [#1082 comment 6899755628](https://github.com/0xRayAI/xray/issues/1082#issuecomment-6899755628)) and my releases file (`house/dist/nibbler/near-releases-2026-11.md`).

## Method
- **Web:** official docs pulled as raw `.md` today (docs.near.org, docs.near-intents.org, docs.business.near.com, near.org blog), GitHub releases (nearcore, near-api-js, near-kit), npm registry metadata, and a shallow clone of `near/agent-skills` to check what the skills actually say.
- **Live checks (read-only):** the `status` RPC on mainnet and testnet, and `tools/list` on the three Mintlify docs MCP endpoints.
- **GitHub code search** to find real builder code, then a license check on each repo.
- **X:** 5 `search_posts_all` calls, 47 posts returned (start_time 2026-05-15 to 2026-09-16 depending on the query). X had little to say about these gaps: builders mention NEAR Connect and gas keys in hackathon threads, but nobody is complaining about them on X. The pain points below come mostly from GitHub issues, release notes and docs caveats, and each is labeled with its source.
- **Hackathon set:** keyword scan of `/workspace/nearhack/all.jsonl` (2,437 submissions). It found 0 mentions of universal accounts, Agent Skills, the Docs MCP or NEAR Connect in submission text, 1 gas-key project and 4 Confidential Intents projects. The text is only the X post, so code search is the better signal.

---

## 1. Universal accounts (`0u…`)
| | |
|---|---|
| What | The account address is the hash of its initial state (code, storage, keys). It's created with a `UniversalStateInit` action through one of three flows: relayer-assisted, self-signed bootstrap, or contract-triggered. A plain `Transfer` to a `0u` address creates an *uninitialized* account that accepts only the matching state init. [docs](https://docs.near.org/protocol/tutorials/creating-universal-accounts) |
| Status | **Live on mainnet now.** nearcore 2.14.0 (2026-10-26) "Stabilized universal accounts … one post-quantum-safe derivation" ([release](https://github.com/near/nearcore/releases/tag/2.14.0)). Voting for protocol 88 started 2026-11-06 (same release note). The live `status` RPC today returns `protocol_version: 88` on **both** mainnet and testnet (node 2.14.1). **The docs are stale:** they still say "As of October 2026, testnet supports universal accounts and mainnet does not yet" ([docs](https://docs.near.org/protocol/tutorials/creating-universal-accounts)). |
| SDK | **near-api-js 7.5.0 (2026-11-11)** adds "protocol-88 universal account support … the UniversalStateInit action, bootstrap nonces" and `Account.createDeterministicAccount()` (NEP-616) ([release](https://github.com/near/near-api-js/releases/tag/near-api-js%407.5.0)). The map's "helpers expected to follow" is now half out of date. **near-kit has nothing yet:** its latest release, 0.20.2 (2026-09-24), has NEP-616 deterministic accounts only and a sandbox on nearcore 2.13.4 ([releases](https://github.com/r-near/near-kit/releases)). |
| Builder code | No hackathon submissions use it (keyword scan, 0 hits). Code search for `UniversalStateInit` returns only infra: nearcore, near-api-js, and `Nearblocks/nearblocks` `packages/nb-utils/src/universal.ts` (license NOASSERTION, so read-only). **No MIT/Apache builder demo exists.** |
| Pain points | (a) The docs contradict the chain, so builders will think mainnet isn't ready (docs quote above vs live RPC). (b) The uninitialized-account trap: "Every other action … fails with `AccountNotInitialized`" ([docs](https://docs.near.org/protocol/tutorials/creating-universal-accounts)). (c) The near-kit path has no support yet, and the docs' Python examples use near-kit. No X complaints found. |
| **Verdict** | **Real gap, and it's ready to build on:** mainnet is live and near-api-js 7.5.0 has it. xray could be first with a demo (deterministic per-agent `0u` accounts). |

## 2. Gas keys (NEP-611)
| | |
|---|---|
| What | An access key with its own prepaid NEAR balance and up to 1,024 parallel nonce lanes. A function-call gas key cannot set an `allowance`. Deleting a key burns its balance, and the delete fails if more than 1 NEAR would burn. [docs](https://docs.near.org/protocol/accounts-contracts/gas-keys) |
| Status | Protocol 86 / nearcore 2.13 ([docs](https://docs.near.org/protocol/accounts-contracts/gas-keys)). near-api-js 7.4.0 (2026-10-23) added the permissions plus `TransferToGasKey`/`WithdrawFromGasKey` ([release](https://github.com/near/near-api-js/releases/tag/near-api-js%407.4.0)). near-kit and the Meteor wallet SDK also have the actions (code search hits in `r-near/near-kit` `packages/near-kit/src/core/actions.ts` and `Meteor-Wallet/meteor_wallet_sdk`). |
| **New constraint (not in the map)** | nearcore 2.14.0 **removed `DelegateV2`**, so "Gas keys … can no longer sign meta transactions at all, since the older `Delegate` action already rejects a gas key signer with `DelegateActionRequiresNonGasKey`". It also rejects `WithdrawFromGasKey` nested in a delegate action ([release](https://github.com/near/nearcore/releases/tag/2.14.0)). **Impact:** x402 `exact` on NEAR runs on a NEP-366 signed delegate action ([x402 NEAR scheme](https://github.com/x402-foundation/x402/blob/main/specs/schemes/exact/scheme_exact_near.md)), so **a gas-key agent fleet cannot pay x402 with its gas keys.** Use a separate normal FC/full key for x402. |
| Builder code | **KratonOS** (MIT): "a 4-lane NEP-611 gas-key multiplexer (3.9 NEAR) with zero nonce collisions" ([X](https://x.com/alr80171/status/2120754132403511456), repo [jubayir-hub-69/KratonOS](https://github.com/jubayir-hub-69/KratonOS), MIT). It's the only hackathon hit. |
| Pain points | (a) Delete burns the balance; "Always `WithdrawFromGasKey` before deleting" ([docs](https://docs.near.org/protocol/accounts-contracts/gas-keys)). (b) No meta-tx or x402 signing (above). (c) The `near-api-js` agent skill doesn't mention gas keys; only the `near-cli-rs` skill does (my grep of near/agent-skills at commit 2026-09-28). No X complaints found. |
| **Verdict** | **Shipped and usable.** Use it for fleet throughput, but the kit must keep the x402 signer key separate (2.14 rule). |

## 3. Confidential Intents
| | |
|---|---|
| What | "A private transaction layer built on top of NEAR Intents … deposits and withdrawals cannot be tracked to each other." There are two paths: add `confidentiality: basic|advanced` to a normal 1Click quote, or use embedded `CONFIDENTIAL_INTENTS` balances with Signed Intent Execution. [quickstart](https://docs.near-intents.org/integration/distribution-channels/1click-api/quickstart/confidential-swaps) |
| Status | Since **2026-10-27**, every 1Click swap settles confidentially with no API change. `nearTxHashes` has no swap hash, only the shield and unshield hashes ([changelog](https://docs.near-intents.org/changelog/overview)). Partner rollout continues: DZap went live on 2026-11-13 ([X @near_intents](https://x.com/near_intents/status/2121254884289004026), [X @dzap_io](https://x.com/dzap_io/status/2121250910655639719)). Confidential tx history is "invite-only for now" ([llms.txt → get-transaction-history](https://docs.near-intents.org/api-reference/account/get-transaction-history)). |
| SDK | `@defuse-protocol/one-click-sdk-typescript` 0.1.26 (2026-09-22) already ships the `confidentiality` enum (I checked the npm tarball's `dist/index.d.ts`). The license is **ISC**: permissive, but not MIT/Apache ([repo](https://github.com/defuse-protocol/one-click-sdk-typescript)). |
| Builder code (MIT) | [Psianturi/sealed-intent](https://github.com/Psianturi/sealed-intent) (`packages/core/src/oneclick.ts`, MIT) · [Eren-dotcom/near-intents-xray](https://github.com/Eren-dotcom/near-intents-xray) (MIT, [X](https://x.com/erensqmi/status/2121684804034801780)) · [Megacollins/lumen](https://github.com/Megacollins/lumen) (MIT, [X](https://x.com/CallMeMegaB/status/2120668701372387748)). Not reusable: `feyyazcigim/solvador-near-intents` (x402 + confidential facilitator, **no license**) and `openfort-xyz/recipes-hub` (**no license**). |
| Pain points | (a) **Tracking:** with no swap hash, builders are writing their own tracers: "Intent Sentinel — NEAR Intents swap gone quiet? trace it, see who acts next" ([X](https://x.com/CryppitHQ/status/2122008102623154450)) and "Where's My Swap — any NEAR Intents order: landed, in flight, or refundable" ([X](https://x.com/CryppitHQ/status/2122008129244459451)). (b) History is invite-only (above). (c) **Small-payment blocker:** origin-to-origin swaps "under $1,000 USD are temporarily blocked" on BSC, Polygon, TON, Optimism, Avalanche, Stellar, Monad, XLayer and ADI since 2026-09-09 ([changelog entry](https://docs.near-intents.org/changelog/entries/2026-09-09-temporary-1000-minimum)), and under $100 on Tron since 2026-09-14 ([changelog](https://docs.near-intents.org/changelog/overview)). Base is not on either list. (d) The agent skill is stale: `near-intents/rules/api-confidential-swaps.md` says "`confidentiality` values: `public` (default)", which predates the 10-27 change ([skill](https://github.com/near/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/near-intents/rules/api-confidential-swaps.md)). |
| **Verdict** | **Not a separate pack.** It's on by default in 1Click. The kit needs a status tracker (shield/unshield hashes) and a chain-minimum guard. Agree with near's "fold into the pay kit". |

## 4. NEAR Agent Skills
| | |
|---|---|
| What | Installable skills: `npx skills add near/agent-skills [--skill <name>]`, with 8 skills (near-ai-cloud, near-api-js, near-cli-rs, near-contract-audit, near-dapp, near-intents, near-kit, near-smart-contracts) ([tools-for-ai](https://docs.near.org/getting-started/tools-for-ai), [repo](https://github.com/near/agent-skills)). The Intents docs point to the same `near-intents` skill ([devkit/skills](https://docs.near-intents.org/integration/devkit/skills)). The `skills` CLI is vercel-labs/skills (MIT) ([repo](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills)). |
| Status | **Stale and unlicensed.** The last commit on main is 2026-09-28 ("Sync near-intents skill with upstream docs"), and GitHub reports no license ([repo API](https://github.com/near/agent-skills)). Things it misses: confidential-by-default (above); `near-intents/rules/deposit-near.md` still imports `useWalletSelector` from `@near-wallet-selector/react`, which the docs call deprecated ([file](https://github.com/near/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/near-intents/rules/deposit-near.md), [docs](https://docs.near.org/tools/near-connect)); and the near-api-js skill has no gas keys, universal accounts or 7.5.0 coverage (my grep). **Not in the map:** NEAR Connect ships its own skills (`near-connect-quickstart`, `near-connect-transactions`) and an `llms.txt` in [azbang/near-connect](https://github.com/azbang/near-connect/tree/main/skills). There's also an official prompts repo, [nearai/near-hackathon-prompt-examples](https://github.com/nearai/near-hackathon-prompt-examples) (no license), whose `00-setup.md` installs the skills. |
| Builder code (MIT) | [drizzy765/podlock](https://github.com/drizzy765/podlock) (MIT; custom `skills/intents-payments/SKILL.md` built on top) · [deafmsn201111-sys/near-autopilot](https://github.com/deafmsn201111-sys/near-autopilot) (MIT, `.claude/skills/`) · [Manvith-Shetty/fuse](https://github.com/Manvith-Shetty/fuse) (MIT). Code search: 24 files contain `npx skills add near/agent-skills`. |
| Pain points | Open issue #17, "[Task] Improve understanding of network in connector" ([issue](https://github.com/near/agent-skills/issues/17)). Closed #20, "market.near.ai skills: operator-level gaps in replay safety, determinism, and reconciliation" ([issue](https://github.com/near/agent-skills/issues/20)). No NEAR-specific complaints on X (the "agent skills" search returned generic posts). |
| **Verdict** | **Useful but stale.** Don't vendor it (no license). xray should ship its own skill that pins near-api-js ≥7.5, NEAR Connect, and confidential-by-default 1Click, and link to near/agent-skills for the rest. |

## 5. Docs MCP
| | |
|---|---|
| What | A hosted, read-only docs search over MCP: "Retrieval (Docs MCP) when the agent needs live lookup", paired with `llms.txt` ([tools-for-ai](https://docs.near.org/getting-started/tools-for-ai)). |
| Status | **Live, and there are three, not one** (the map lists one). The `tools/list` calls today returned: `https://docs.near.org/mcp` → `search_near_docs`, `query_docs_filesystem_near_docs`; `https://docs.near-intents.org/mcp` → `search_near_intents`, `query_docs_filesystem_near_intents`, `submit_feedback`; `https://docs.near.ai/mcp` → `search_near_ai`, `query_docs_filesystem_near_ai`, `submit_feedback`. None needed an API key. |
| Separate from | The **NEAR MCP server** ([nearai/near-mcp](https://github.com/nearai/near-mcp), MIT, last push 2025-05-04) holds keys and runs locally only ([tools-for-ai](https://docs.near.org/getting-started/tools-for-ai)). |
| Builder code (MIT) | Builders reference it in agent instruction files: [7maylord/coffer](https://github.com/7maylord/coffer) `AGENTS.md` (MIT) · [devluca999/evernear](https://github.com/devluca999/evernear) `CLAUDE.md` (MIT) · [suyash101101/ClearDeed](https://github.com/suyash101101/ClearDeed) `PLAN.md` (MIT). Code search found 16 files with `docs.near.org/mcp`. |
| Pain points | None found on X or in issues. Risk: the docs MCP serves the same stale pages (for example the universal-accounts mainnet note in §1). |
| **Verdict** | **Zero-cost win:** put all three endpoints in the xray kit's `.mcp.json`. |

## 6. NEAR Connect (replaces Wallet Selector)
| | |
|---|---|
| What | A zero-dependency wallet connector that runs wallet code in sandboxed iframes from a shared manifest. It supports HOT, Meteor, Nightly, WalletConnect and "10+ others". The docs say: "Do not use NEAR Wallet Selector" ([docs](https://docs.near.org/tools/near-connect)). |
| Status | `@hot-labs/near-connect` 0.12.0 (npm modified 2026-10-26). npm says `license = MIT`, but the **GitHub repo has no LICENSE file** (GitHub `license: null`, root listing has none) and the npm `repository.url` points to `hot-dao/near-selector` while the docs link `azbang/near-connect` ([repo](https://github.com/azbang/near-connect)). Official adoption: `near/create-near-app` templates, `near-examples/near-multichain`, `nearai/ironclaw` web UI, and Nearblocks all depend on it (code search `@hot-labs/near-connect filename:package.json`, 270 hits). |
| Builder code (MIT) | Hackathon threads: "Wallet sign-in through NEAR Connect, MetaMask included" ([X](https://x.com/JeskinsJoshva/status/2121754571433529462)); "NEAR Connect + NEP-413 message signing" ([X](https://x.com/kuvos_AI/status/2121730658297131190)); a smartwatch hardware wallet added to NEAR Connect via a Chrome extension ([X](https://x.com/hope_rythmn/status/2121744734452650164)). Migration lag: a Nov 14 hackathon build still uses "Meteor + Wallet Selector" ([X](https://x.com/Versatilepen/status/2121696609331233023)). |
| Pain points (GitHub issues, open) | "WalletConnect: signAndSendTransactions always fails with 'Expected string not undefined(undefined) at value.signerId'" ([#120](https://github.com/azbang/near-connect/issues/120), 2026-11-05) · "Unable to sign in or Pay with NEAR" ([#100](https://github.com/azbang/near-connect/issues/100)) · "`WalletManifest.platform` is mistyped" ([#94](https://github.com/azbang/near-connect/issues/94)) · "Cannot sign in with popup in FF" ([#55](https://github.com/azbang/near-connect/issues/55)) · "Invalid signature timestamp: future timestamp" ([#53](https://github.com/azbang/near-connect/issues/53)) · "Improve the UX for mobile browser users" ([#42](https://github.com/azbang/near-connect/issues/42)). 19 open issues in total (repo API). |
| **Verdict** | **Use it, but pin the version** and avoid the WalletConnect batch-sign path until #120 is fixed. The license is ambiguous (npm MIT, no repo file), so depend on it but don't vendor it. |

## Other items missing from near's map / #1100 (and from my releases file)
1. **NEAR Business, a confidential multisig treasury (launched 2026-10-20).** Each treasury is "governed by a SputnikDAO multisig contract on NEAR mainnet", funds sit in NEAR Intents on the private shard, it uses MPC threshold signing, and "NEAR Business holds no key or key share" ([blog](https://www.near.org/blog/introducing-near-business), [docs](https://docs.business.near.com/confidential-treasuries)). It's not in the map or my file, and **it contradicts the map's "never act on one key alone: no official primitive"** row. Caveats: funds sent to non-near.com networks by mistake "might be lost" ([docs](https://docs.business.near.com/guides/funding-confidential-treasuries)), and it's an app, not an SDK, so check before assuming an API exists.
2. **nearcore 2.14 rule changes for agent builders** ([release](https://github.com/near/nearcore/releases/tag/2.14.0)): `DelegateV2` removed and gas keys can't sign meta-tx (§2); the gas rebate went from 30% to 0% (HSP-027), which kills "contract earns from gas" models; and a new `ml_dsa_verify` host function (post-quantum ML-DSA-65 signature verification on-chain). My releases file mentions the rebate and ML-DSA; the map has none of these.
3. **Intents temporary quote minimums**, $1,000 on 9 chains and $100 on Tron ([changelog](https://docs.near-intents.org/changelog/overview)). Not in the map. It directly limits small agent payments off those chains.
4. **Intents token-ID breaking change (2026-11-09):** BNB, Polygon and Avalanche now use Omni `nep141` IDs. "Replace hardcoded legacy HOT `nep245` IDs" ([changelog](https://docs.near-intents.org/changelog/overview)). The map mentions Omni but not this change.
5. **The docs MCPs for Intents and NEAR AI** (§5), plus their `submit_feedback` tool, which gives us a way to report stale docs.
6. **near-api-js 7.5.0** (universal + deterministic accounts, `decodeSignedDelegate()` for meta-tx) ([release](https://github.com/near/near-api-js/releases/tag/near-api-js%407.5.0)). It's in my releases file but not the map; the map still says "expected to follow".
7. **Stale official docs to flag upstream:** the universal-accounts mainnet note (§1); the near-intents skill's "public default" (§3); and the skill's Wallet Selector import (§4).
8. **License ambiguities:** agent-skills (no license), near-connect (npm MIT but no repo file), and the 1Click TS SDK (ISC). Mill should confirm before anything is vendored.

## What this means for xray kits (dead-simple path)
- **Accounts:** near-api-js ≥7.5.0 → per-agent `0u` universal accounts (mainnet live) + scoped FC keys; gas keys for throughput; **a separate non-gas key for x402/meta-tx**.
- **Pay:** 1Click (confidential by default) + our own status tracker (shield/unshield hashes) + a chain-minimum guard; prefer Base routes (not under the minimums).
- **Treasury / never-one-key:** evaluate NEAR Business (SputnikDAO + MPC + private shard) before building our own multisig pack.
- **Dev experience:** ship `.mcp.json` with the 3 docs MCPs + an xray skill that corrects the stale near/agent-skills bits; NEAR Connect pinned for the front end.

## Unverified / open
- Whether NEAR Business exposes an API/SDK for agents (I found docs for the app only).
- When the $1,000 / $100 Intents minimums will lift (the changelog only says "temporarily").
- When near-kit will add universal accounts (no issue or PR checked this pass).
